dialogue.origin: こんにちは、相談員です。
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm the counselor.

dialogue.origin: ご相談をはじめる前に、性別と年齢、あと何とお呼びすればいいか教えていただけますか？あだ名でも大丈夫です。
dialogue.content: Before we begin our session, could you please tell me your gender, age, and what you would like me to call you? A nickname is fine.

dialogue.origin: 40代女性です。モコと呼んでください
dialogue.content: I'm a woman in my 40s. Please call me Moko.

dialogue.origin: モコさんですね、よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Moko, is that right? It's nice to meet you.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: It's nice to meet you too.

dialogue.origin: それでは、本日はどのようなご相談ですか？
dialogue.content: So, what would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.origin: 実は、次男と結婚したのですが、急に実家を継がなくてはならなくなり、困惑しています。
dialogue.content: Actually, I married a second son, but we suddenly have to take over his family's home, and I'm at a loss.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、突然のことで驚かれましたよね
dialogue.content: I see. That must have been a sudden shock for you.

dialogue.origin: そうなのです。
dialogue.content: It was.

dialogue.origin: 急に継がなくてはならなくなったきっかけはどんなものですか？
dialogue.content: What led to this sudden need to take over?

dialogue.origin: 義兄が倒れてしまったのです。
dialogue.content: My brother-in-law collapsed.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか…大変でしたね
dialogue.content: Oh, I'm sorry to hear that. That must have been very difficult.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: モコさんは実家を継ぐことに関してはどう思いますか？
dialogue.content: How do you feel about taking over the family home, Moko?

dialogue.origin: 突然のことで、嫌というの申し訳ない気がして
dialogue.content: It all happened so suddenly that I feel guilty saying I don't want to.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、気持ちを伝えられないのはつらいですね
dialogue.content: I see. It must be painful not being able to express how you feel.

dialogue.origin: ご主人は継ぐことに関してはどのように言われていますか？
dialogue.content: What has your husband said about taking over?

dialogue.origin: 仕方ない。と言っています。
dialogue.content: He says, "It can't be helped."

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 義兄さん家族とは何かお話されましたか？
dialogue.content: Have you spoken with your brother-in-law's family?

dialogue.origin: それどころではないので、義姉から、夫に家のことをお願いしますといわれ
dialogue.content: We're in no position to talk about it; my sister-in-law just asked my husband to please take care of the house.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、かなり急を要する状況なのですね
dialogue.content: I see, so it's a very urgent situation.

dialogue.origin: はい。義父も年を取っているので。
dialogue.content: Yes. My father-in-law is getting older, too.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、不安になる状況ですね
dialogue.content: That's understandable; it's a situation that would make anyone anxious.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ご主人は今の仕事をやめて、実家を継ぐ、という形になるんですか？
dialogue.content: Does this mean your husband will quit his current job to take over the family home?

dialogue.origin: 仕事はそのままですが、実家の片付けや、義父の身の回りのことなどをどうするかなどです。
dialogue.content: He'll keep his job, but we need to figure out what to do about things like clearing out the family home and taking care of my father-in-law's daily needs.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、家の長になるという意味なんですね
dialogue.content: I see, so it means he'll become the head of the household.

dialogue.origin: すみません、勘違いしていました
dialogue.content: I'm sorry, I misunderstood.

dialogue.origin: そうなのです。
dialogue.content: That's right.

dialogue.origin: となるとモカさんは、長男の嫁、のような形になるわけですね
dialogue.content: In that case, Moko, you would be taking on a role similar to the wife of the eldest son, wouldn't you?

dialogue.origin: ご主人が家の長になるにあたり、どんなことが一番困惑していますか？
dialogue.content: As your husband becomes the head of the household, what is most confusing or troubling for you?

dialogue.origin: それもありますが、夫が継ぐと、息子が、継ぐことになるので、それは無理だろうと思うのと、私も、手伝いに行くようにしなくてはならなくなるのが
dialogue.content: There's that, but if my husband takes over, then our son would be expected to take over in the future, which I don't think is feasible, and I would also have to go and help out...

dialogue.origin: 心配です。
dialogue.content: That's what worries me.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、モコさんのご家族に大きな変化が起こりますよね
dialogue.content: I see. This will bring about a big change for your family, won't it?

dialogue.origin: はい。今までのペースでは、過ごせなくなります。
dialogue.content: Yes. We won't be able to live at our current pace anymore.

dialogue.origin: 時々手伝いに行くのは構わないのですが、主となるのは不安です。
dialogue.content: I don't mind going to help out sometimes, but I'm anxious about taking on the primary responsibility.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね、責任がのしかかってきますものね
dialogue.content: That makes sense—the responsibility would weigh heavily on you.

dialogue.origin: どんなことが一番不安に感じますか？
dialogue.content: What are you most anxious about?

dialogue.origin: やれるだけといわれても、そうはいかなくなるのと、
dialogue.content: Even if they say, "Just do what you can," it won't be that simple,

dialogue.origin: 仕事しながらというのは、難しいなあと。県外なので
dialogue.content: and I think it will be difficult to manage while working, since it's in another prefecture.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、遠方なんですね、それはしんどくなりそうですね…
dialogue.content: I see, so it's far away. That sounds like it would be very tiring...

dialogue.origin: 立ち入ったことをお聞きしますが、ご主人の実家は、どんな家なんでしょうか？
dialogue.content: This may be a personal question, but what kind of home is your husband's family home?

dialogue.origin: はい。隣の県なのですが、3時間くらいかかるので。
dialogue.content: Yes. It's in the neighboring prefecture, and it takes about three hours to get there.

dialogue.origin: 普通の農家です。
dialogue.content: It's an ordinary farming household.

dialogue.origin: 今は農業はしていません。
dialogue.content: They aren't farming now.

dialogue.origin: ええ！？3時間ですか、それは遠い…
dialogue.content: Wow—three hours? That's far...

dialogue.origin: 義父が一人で住んでいます。
dialogue.content: My father-in-law lives there alone.

dialogue.origin: なるほどなるほど
dialogue.content: I see, I see.

dialogue.origin: 土地が広大にありそうですね、その管理も必要になるかもしれませんね
dialogue.content: It sounds like there may be a lot of land, and managing it might also become necessary.

dialogue.origin: 広大ではないですが、農地はあります。
dialogue.content: It's not vast, but there is farmland.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: モコさんとしては、どのような形になるのが一番いいですか？
dialogue.content: From your perspective, Moko, what would be the ideal situation?

dialogue.origin: 今は、夫が動くのは仕方ないとは思いますが、義姉が、継ぐことが出来ればと思いますが、義兄の状態次第で巣から、何も言えません。
dialogue.content: Right now, I think it can't be helped that my husband has to step in, but I wish my sister-in-law could take over. However, since it all depends on my brother-in-law's condition, I can't say anything.

dialogue.origin: なるほどなるほど、教えていただきありがとうございます
dialogue.content: I see, I see. Thank you for sharing that with me.

dialogue.origin: 継ぐしかないとなれば仕方ないことですが、息子には関わらせたくないです。
dialogue.content: If we have no choice but to take over, then so be it, but I don't want to get my son involved.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね、息子さんに負担を負わせたくないですものね
dialogue.content: I understand—you don't want to burden your son.

dialogue.origin: はい。それが一番だと今はなしていて気づきました
dialogue.content: Yes. Talking about it now, I've realized that's the most important thing.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね、息子さん心配ですものね
dialogue.content: I see. Of course you'd be worried about your son.

dialogue.origin: 息子さんは今回のことはご存知なんですか？
dialogue.content: Does your son know about this situation?

dialogue.origin: いろいろな田舎の関係などを、理解するのは、難しいと思います。
dialogue.content: I think it's hard for him to understand the various rural relationships and obligations.

dialogue.origin: はいもちろん知っています。
dialogue.content: Yes, of course he knows.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、家柄関係は複雑ですよね
dialogue.content: Yes, family-line matters can be complicated.

dialogue.origin: 息子さんはおいくつなんですか？
dialogue.content: How old is your son?

dialogue.origin: 小さいころから、見たり聞いたりして、なんとなく覚えていくものだと思うので、社会人になった今では難しいです。
dialogue.content: I think it's something you gradually absorb from a young age by seeing and hearing it, so it's difficult for him now that he's a working adult.

dialogue.origin: 24です
dialogue.content: He's 24.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます、そうですよね、自立されている今、引き継がせるのは避けたいですよね
dialogue.content: Thank you. Yes, I understand. Now that he's independent, you want to avoid making him take over.

dialogue.origin: いままでのお話を整理させていただこうと思うのですがよろしいですか？
dialogue.content: I'd like to summarize what we've talked about so far, if that's okay with you.

dialogue.origin: はい。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: モコさんのご主人は次男で、急に実家を継がなければいけなくなった
dialogue.content: Your husband is the second son, and he suddenly needs to take over the family home.

dialogue.origin: 義兄さんが倒れてしまい、急を要する
dialogue.content: Your brother-in-law collapsed, making the situation urgent.

dialogue.origin: 継ぐとなると、実家の片付けや、義父の身の回りのことなどをやらなくてはいけない
dialogue.content: If you take over, you'll have to handle things like clearing out the house and your father-in-law's daily needs.

dialogue.origin: 負担がかなり大きい
dialogue.content: The burden is quite significant.

dialogue.origin: 息子さんもいずれ実家を継ぐことになりそうで、それは一番避けたい
dialogue.content: Your son might eventually be expected to take over as well, and that's what you most want to avoid.

dialogue.origin: こんな感じだと思いますが、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: That's how I understand it—does that sound right?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そうです。
dialogue.content: That's right.

dialogue.origin: かなり大変な状況ですよね
dialogue.content: It's a very difficult situation, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: 先ほども言いましたが、お話をすることで、自分が一番避けたいことが見えたので、良かったです。
dialogue.content: As I said earlier, by talking about it, I was able to see what I want to avoid the most, so that was good.

dialogue.origin: それはよかったです
dialogue.content: I'm glad to hear that.

dialogue.origin: 私から微力ながらお伝えさせていただきたいと思いますがよろしいですか？
dialogue.content: I'd like to offer a suggestion, if that's alright?

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: ↑お伝えしたいこと　の間違いです
dialogue.content: My apologies, that was a typo in my previous message.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: とても大変な状況だと思うのですが
dialogue.content: I know this is a very difficult situation, but...

dialogue.origin: ここはひとつ、息子さんに負担や不安をかけないために、
dialogue.content: to avoid placing a burden or anxiety on your son,

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: モコさんが実家を継ぐという状況を少しずつ受け入れていくのがいいと思います
dialogue.content: I think it might be best for you, Moko, to gradually start accepting the situation of taking over the family home.

dialogue.origin: 課題がかなり積み重なっているので、不安が重なると思いますが
dialogue.content: There are many issues piling up, so I imagine the anxiety accumulates as well, but

dialogue.origin: ひとつずつ、ご主人と話し合って、いずれは義姉さんともお話していく
dialogue.content: you can discuss them one by one with your husband, and eventually, with your sister-in-law as well.

dialogue.origin: このような形がいいと思います。いかがですか？
dialogue.content: I think an approach like this might be good. What do you think?

dialogue.origin: そうですね。
dialogue.content: You're right.

dialogue.origin: 話し合っていきたいと思います。
dialogue.content: I'd like to try and talk things over.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: はい、こちらこそありがとうございました
dialogue.content: You're welcome. Thank you as well.

dialogue.origin: ではご相談を終了させていただきたいと思いますが、よろしいですか？
dialogue.content: Then, I would like to conclude our session, if that's okay?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 本日はご相談ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you for your consultation today.

topic.sub: 義兄の倒れによる実家継承の問題
